text: Program Description Developmental biology is one of important basic branches of biological science, the research content and many other disciplines content mutual penetration, complex, especially in molecular biology and genetics, cell biology, the relationship between the most closely. The application of modern science and technology and method, from the molecular level, and the microscopic level and cell level to study the biology from the happening of the sperm and eggs, fertilization, development, growth and aging death process and its mechanism. Duration 3 years
